evaluated_repository: VulnGuard (this repository), labeled fixture cohort data/test_vulns

metrics.definition: accepted repairs on the first attempt / eligible vulnerable cases attempted, where accepted requires a valid baseline exploit, an applied patch, passing build/syntax + functional tests, and a neutralised exploit
metrics.evidence: no case satisfies every strict criterion: patches were never applied to a workspace (patch_probe.json: applications_succeeded=0)

metrics.definition: same as M1a but allowing up to three attempts
metrics.evidence: no retries were ever scheduled (retry_scheduled=0 in every case), so PSR@3 == PSR@1

metrics.definition: cases whose Judge verdict is PASS / eligible vulnerable cases attempted
metrics.evidence: cases/C03.json: judge_verdict=PASS

metrics.definition: valid baseline exploits confirmed blocked by the candidate repair / eligible valid baseline exploits tested
metrics.evidence: only C03 produced a valid baseline exploit (exploit_status=AVAILABLE, harness present, expected_stdout_regex set); C01/C02/C04/C05 had no usable harness, C06 had no finding, so they are ineligible for EBR

metrics.definition: candidate repairs that break a previously passing functional test / repairs with a valid regression comparison
metrics.evidence: the Judge never executes the baseline test suite; logs/11-regression-capability-probe.log shows `python3 -m pytest -x` collecting 0 tests (exit 5) on the fixture repository, which judge_agent._run_tests converts into a pass ('No tests discovered; regression test step skipped'). No case has a baseline-vs-patched test comparison.

metrics.definition: successfully applied candidate patches / candidate patch-application attempts
metrics.evidence: patch_probe.json: every apply_patch call raises NameError('time' is not defined) at vulnguard/sandbox/patcher.py:69 because the module never imports `time`

metrics.definition: syntactically invalid candidate patches / candidate patches checked
metrics.evidence: patch_probe.json: validate_syntax() passes on all spliced patched sources; the application failure is a mechanism defect, not a malformed patch

metrics.definition: cases that failed the first attempt and were later accepted / cases that failed the first attempt and were retried
metrics.evidence: 5 first-attempt failures occurred but 0 were retried: every failure was a terminal evidence verdict (EXPLOIT_INVALID/EXPLOIT_NOT_REPRODUCED) or a clean negative, which judge_agent routes to FAILED/END instead of the Blue retry loop

metrics.definition: pipeline_end - pipeline_start per case, seconds (excludes repository ingestion, parsing and ML triage; includes LLM inference, Docker sandbox execution and any retries)
metrics.evidence: median=114.1s mean=112.9s min=63.2s max=163.5s (cases/*.json elapsed_seconds)

metrics.definition: total attributable LLM cost of all evaluated attempts / accepted repairs
metrics.evidence: total cost $0.6300 over 6 cases and 35 provider calls; sum of per-case estimated_cost_usd from data/llm_usage.jsonl

metrics.metric: Token cost per strict security-correct fix (USD)
metrics.definition: total attributable LLM cost / strictly accepted repairs
metrics.evidence: strictly accepted repairs = 0, so the ratio is undefined (division by zero)

metrics.definition: cases where the Red Agent reported a defect / known-vulnerable cases
metrics.evidence: cases/*.json vulnerability_found; the single miss is C06 (cross-file taint entry point)

metrics.definition: reported CWE equal to the documented category of the fixture / cases with a reported CWE
metrics.evidence: expected CWE-89/78/121/134/367 for C01-C05 from the fixture comments in data/test_vulns

metrics.metric: Judge acceptance rate (of cases that reached the Judge)
metrics.definition: PASS verdicts / cases with any Judge verdict
metrics.evidence: cases/*.json judge_verdict non-empty

metrics.definition: cases with a candidate patch / detected cases
metrics.evidence: cases/*.json patched_code present

metrics.metric: Compilation / syntax-check success rate for candidate patches
metrics.definition: patched sources passing the application's validate_syntax / candidate patches
metrics.evidence: patch_probe.json syntax_valid

metrics.definition: cases accepted on attempt 1 / cases attempted
metrics.evidence: cases/*.json attempt_number=0 for every case (only one attempt was ever executed)

metrics.definition: cases with no accepted (PASS) repair / cases attempted
metrics.evidence: cases/*.json judge_verdict != PASS

metrics.metric: ML triage detection on the labeled cohort
metrics.definition: labeled vulnerable functions flagged at the deployed threshold / labeled vulnerable functions
metrics.evidence: ml_eval.json labeled_cohort; note 4/6 are above threshold on the model's own probability, 2/6 only via the static-signal floor (ml_raw_probability.json)

metrics.metric: ML triage selection ratio on unlabeled code
metrics.definition: functions flagged / functions extracted from vulnguard/ (unlabeled — a workload ratio, not accuracy)
metrics.evidence: ml_eval.json repo_selection

metrics.metric: Functions prioritized for LLM analysis (fixture cohort)
metrics.definition: functions flagged by triage among those parsed from data/test_vulns / functions parsed from data/test_vulns
metrics.evidence: ml_eval.json fixture_selection (per-function rows included)
